title: John Lennon and Ringo Starr jam in Los Angeles | 1974
content:
Record Plant, Los Angeles
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon and Ringo Starr jammed at the Record Plant in Los Angeles on 3 March 1974.

This was an anniversary party for the drinking group known as the Jim Keltner Fan Club. Eric ‘Mouse’ Johnson joined Starr and Keltner on drums, and the guitarists included Lennon, Jesse Ed Davis, and Marc Benno. Also present were Gene Clark, Bobby Keys, Ric Grech, and Joe Vitale.
